sections.1_problem: Implanted ICP/pressure sensing drifts (recorded typical 1-10 mmHg/month class), demanding periodic recalibration or accepting degraded accuracy over implant lifetime; for a catheter-integrated CSF sensor, drift is the accuracy budget's dominant error source. The dossier records the clinical utility bar as achievable drift (UNKNOWN, critical).
sections.2_existing_limitation: A single-ended piezoresistive sensor's zero and sensitivity drift with temperature and time; existing drift-compensation approaches include trimming, calibration cycles, and differential/reference architectures in the general sensor literature (external precedent cited: S0924424724006095) — but for THIS application no measured baseline-vs-self-referencing comparison exists, and the competitive landscape (Codman/Raumedic/Sophysa, GWM 510(k) predicates K161853/K231664) is recorded as market context, not prior-art evidence.
sections.3_proposed_technology: A catheter-integrated piezoresistive pressure sensor with a SELF-REFERENCING bridge: an active pressure-exposed diaphragm element plus a dummy pressure-shielded element sharing the thermal environment; the bridge output cancels common-mode thermal drift. Shipped CAD: sensor die (diaphragm 0.07 mm class) + reference die + carrier platform.
sections.4_mechanism: Bridge output V_out = (R_active(T,P) - R_dummy(T))/(4R)*V_ex: temperature common-mode shifts appear on both elements and cancel in the differential output; sensitivity scales with diaphragm thickness (~1/t^2, MODELLED, x2.939 for the KEEP mutation 0.12 -> 0.07 mm). What the mechanism does NOT cancel: NON-common-mode drift — asymmetric fouling of the exposed active element (the exact recorded kill channel of predecessor P-25: 67.8 % cancellation but 3.45 mmHg error, biofouling dominant; lesson KA-014).

sections.8_known_unknowns: Achievable drift rate with self-referencing (critical); the non-common-mode fouling channel (P-25's kill cause — uncompensated by design); reference-element stability; cycling endurance (a field the dossier lacks); the ~1-2 mmHg accuracy target's clinical derivation; prior-art position (no search exists); manufacturing process; regulatory pathway. None converted to certainty.

The improvement RATIO is the primary endpoint (a stable sensor without self-referencing would NOT validate this architecture).
